# Copilot Instructions — 健身工作室管理系統

This is a fitness studio booking/management system: **FastAPI (Python) + PostgreSQL** backend, **React + TypeScript + Ant Design (Vite)** frontend, Docker Compose for local orchestration. **Multi-tenant SaaS** — many unrelated gyms share one deployment; see «Multi-tenancy» below and `docs/adr/0001-multi-tenancy.md`. All identifiers, UI copy, and comments in this repo are in **Traditional Chinese** — match that convention in new code.

## Platform console (ADR 0002)

- Lives at `platform.<BASE_DOMAIN>` (`PLATFORM_SUBDOMAIN`, reserved — never a gym). Same frontend/API, split by host: `App.tsx` builds only one router (`isPlatformHost()` from `lib/host.ts` → `router/platform.tsx`, else `router/index.tsx`; both are `create…Router()` functions); `/api/v1/platform/*` (`routers/platform.py`) is router-gated by `deps.require_platform_host` → 404 on gym hosts, and the platform host is not a gym (gym APIs 404 there).
- Separate accounts: `platform_admins` (+ `platform_audit_logs`) — no `tenant_id`, no RLS, listed in `models/platform.PLATFORM_TABLE_NAMES`. Platform JWT (`create_platform_token`) carries `scope=platform` and no `tid`; `get_current_user` rejects any token with a `scope`, `get_current_platform_admin` requires it. Frontend keeps it in a separate store/client (`store/platformAuth.ts`, `api/platformClient.ts` + `api/platform.ts`).
- Third DB role `fitness_platform` (`PLATFORM_DATABASE_URL`, `deps.get_platform_db`): R/W `tenants`/`platform_admins`, R/insert `platform_audit_logs`, R/W `users` **under RLS** (switch with `db.session.act_as_tenant(db, tenant_id)` inside the transaction — only for managing that gym's admins), no grant on other business tables. Cross-tenant numbers only via the `SECURITY DEFINER` function `platform_tenant_stats(month_start)` (aggregates only). The app role has no access to platform tables.
- `services/tenants.py` is shared by the API and `app.cli`: subdomain rules (`subdomain_problem`, `RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS`), `create_tenant`, `create_tenant_admin`, `reset_tenant_admin_password` (admins only, never members/coaches), `audit()` + `AUDIT_ACTIONS`. Functions only flush — provisioning tenant + first admin + audit is one transaction. They also filter `tenant_id` explicitly because the CLI's owner connection bypasses RLS.
- Endpoints: `POST /platform/auth/login` (JSON), `GET /auth/me`, `POST /auth/change-password`; `GET/POST /platform/tenants`, `GET /tenants/check-subdomain`, `GET/PUT /tenants/{id}` (subdomain immutable), `POST /tenants/{id}/status` `{status, reason}`, `GET/POST /tenants/{id}/admins`, `POST /tenants/{id}/admins/{uid}/reset-password`, `GET /platform/audit-logs?tenant_id&limit`. Every state change writes an audit row (no passwords).
- UI (`pages/platform/`): `Login`, `TenantList` (summary stats, search, status `Segmented`), `TenantForm` (開通: live subdomain check, timezone, contact, first admin + generated password; shows credentials once via the shared `components/credentials.tsx`), `TenantDetail/` (info card with dirty-diff save, status card with 停用 reason modal + usage stats, admins card, audit log), `AuditLogs`, `Account`. Shared `components/platform/AuditLogTable.tsx`. `StatusTag` colours 試用/啟用/停用.
- First platform admin: `PLATFORM_ADMIN_USERNAME`/`PASSWORD` at container start, or `python -m app.cli create-platform-admin`.
- Tenant-host cache: hits 30 s, misses 5 s, and creating a gym clears the local cache.

## Gym website (ADR 0003)

- Each gym's **home page `/` is its public website**, server-rendered by FastAPI + Jinja2 (`routers/site.py`, `templates/site/` layouts, `static/site/*.css` mounted at `/site/static`) — no JavaScript (menus/FAQ are `<details>`, the trial form is a plain POST → 303). Unpublished ⇒ `/` redirects to `/login`. `frontend/nginx.conf` and `vite.config.ts` send `/` (except on the platform host), `/site/*`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml` to the backend with `Host: $http_host`; everything else stays SPA.
- Content: one `websites` row per tenant with `draft` and `published` JSON, shape/validation in `schemas/website.py` `SiteContent` (sections hero/about/schedule/coaches/pricing/gallery/faq/trial/contact, order + visibility; hero/about/contact required; empty sections auto-hide). Coaches/products are stored as ids + website copy only — names, photos, prices and sessions are read live; the class list comes from `services/schedule.group_sessions` (shared with `GET /courses/schedule`). Six themes in `SITE_THEMES`, all on the same content; each names a layout `template`: `bold` 活力 / `airy` 清爽 / `warm` 溫暖 use the stacked `templates/site/bold.html` (`site.css` is bold; `airy`/`warm` add `static/site/theme-<key>.css` that only overrides colours/fonts/shapes; `warm` loads Noto Serif TC), and `bento` 方格 uses `templates/site/bento.html` + `static/site/bento.css` — each section is its own 4-column grid band (`.band`, tiles `c2`/`c4`/`r2`, dense packing only inside a band so reading order follows the configured section order; 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile), with hero extras「下一堂團體課」(`next_class` from `render_site`) and 方案起價 (`cheapest_plan`, the lowest-priced plan, not the first listed); `editorial` 雜誌 uses `templates/site/editorial.html` + `static/site/editorial.css` (paper background, Noto Serif TC, numbered chapters 01/02… in section order with hero unnumbered, sticky left head + wide right body, pricing as a dotted-leader price list, 「圖 N」 captions); `sidebar` 側欄 uses `templates/site/sidebar.html` + `static/site/sidebar.css` (≥ 900px: fixed left `<aside class="sb-side">` nav and the shared header hidden; each section is a white `.card`; a stats row under the hero shows 下一堂團體課 / 方案起價 / 教練人數; < 900px falls back to the shared header menu). All layouts extend `templates/site/_layout.html` (head/header/footer/mobile CTA) and share `_trial_form.html` / `_contact_info.html` — **add new sections to every layout** (bold, bento, editorial, sidebar). Body class `theme-<key>`, per-theme `theme_color`; the editor's 網站設定 panel picks one via `pages/admin/Website/components/ThemePicker.tsx` (mini previews from `SITE_THEMES` in `api/website.ts`). `brand_color` is limited to the 5 `BRAND_COLORS`, contrast-checked ≥ 4.5:1 on every theme's backgrounds — re-check if you change a theme's background colours.
- **Public-field whitelist** (R16): `_coaches`/`_plans` in `routers/site.py` pass only alias/name, specialty, photo, website bio, product name/category/hours/price to the template. Never hand ORM objects to the template. Links validated in the schema (LINE `@id`/lin.ee/line.me, Instagram username, https facebook.com); images must be `/media/<own subdomain>/site/<uuid>.jpg|png` (checked on save and publish).
- Admin API `routers/website.py` (admin-only): `GET /website`, `PUT /website/draft`, `POST /website/publish|unpublish|discard-draft|preview-token|upload-image` (jpg/png ≤ 5MB). Preview: `/site/preview?token=` with a 30-min `scope=site_preview` JWT (`create_site_preview_token`; can't call APIs).
- Trial enquiries: `POST /site/inquiry` (honeypot field `website`, ≤3 per IP-hash per 10 min, consent required) → `inquiries` (+ `inquiry_notes`), statuses 新詢問/聯絡中/已約體驗/已成為會員/未成交 (stored `new`/`contacting`/`trial_booked`/`converted`/`lost`). `routers/inquiries.py` (admin): list (+ lazy purge of non-converted enquiries older than 183 days, R18), `/summary` (sidebar badge), `PATCH` status (not 已成為會員), `POST /{id}/notes` (first note moves 新詢問→聯絡中), `POST /{id}/convert` (creates a member, `must_change_password` default true).
- UI: admin sidebar **形象網站** (`pages/admin/Website/`: `SectionNav` + one panel per section in `components/panels/` + `PreviewPane` iframe + sticky 捨棄草稿/儲存草稿/發布到網站 bar; panel labels are linked via `htmlFor`/`id`) and **詢問名單** (`pages/admin/Inquiries.tsx`, drawer with status/notes/convert, badge with new count). `components/credentials.tsx` (`showCredentials`, takes a `loginUrl`) is shared with the platform console. Rules R16–R19 in `docs/business-rules.md`.

## LINE store notifications (ADR 0004)

- One **shared platform LINE Official Account** (Messaging API; LINE Notify is gone). Secrets only in env: `LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET`, `LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `LINE_BOT_BASIC_ID` (+ `LINE_BOT_NAME`, `LINE_PLAN_MONTHLY_QUOTA`, `PUBLIC_SCHEME` for card links, `LINE_DISPATCH_INTERVAL_SECONDS`). All three unset ⇒ `services/line.get_client()` is None ⇒ notifications are recorded 未設定 LINE and the UI shows a warning. Never put secrets in the DB or UI.
- Tables: `line_recipients` (`line_user_id`, `display_name`, `notify_inquiry`/`notify_payment`/`notify_booking`, `is_active`, `bound_by_name`), `line_bind_codes` (sha256 `code_hash` only, 10 min, single use), `line_notifications` (outbox: `recipient_ids`/`message` JSON cleared once finished, `status` 待發送/重試中/成功/失敗/超過上限/未設定 LINE stored `pending`/`retrying`/`sent`/`failed`/`skipped_cap`/`skipped_disabled`, `attempts`, `next_attempt_at`, `note`) — all tenant/RLS; platform table `line_bind_attempts` (rate limit 5 failures / 10 min per LINE user). `tenants.line_monthly_cap` (default 300, edited via `PUT /platform/tenants/{id}`, audited).
- Events (`services/line.notify_inquiry|notify_payment|notify_booking`, each with `enqueue` in the request's transaction, then `line.schedule(background_tasks, id)` after commit): `site.submit_inquiry`, `purchases.create_self_purchase`, `reservations.create_reservation` **only when member-submitted**. Cards are minimal (R22): surname only via `masked_name` (王先生／小姐), **never phone/email/notes**; button links to `{PUBLIC_SCHEME}://{sub}.{BASE_DOMAIN}/admin/...`.
- Dispatch (`dispatch_tenant`/`dispatch_all_due`, background thread from `main.lifespan`): claims rows `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, monthly cap counted from the tenant-local month start (skips ⇒ 超過上限), multicast ≤500, retryable errors (no status/429/5xx) retry at 1/5/30 min then 失敗.
- Admin API `routers/line.py` (admin-only, `/line`): `GET /settings`, `POST /bind-codes`, `GET /bind-codes/{id}` (poll: waiting/bound/expired), `PATCH|DELETE /recipients/{id}` (delete = deactivate), `POST /recipients/{id}/test`. Webhook `routers/line_webhook.py` `POST /api/v1/line/webhook` — **platform host only**, verifies `x-line-signature`, uses `get_platform_db`; follow → welcome reply, unfollow → `line_deactivate_user`, 6-digit text → `line_consume_bind_code` (SECURITY DEFINER, binds only if exactly one active code matches) then `act_as_tenant` to create/reactivate the recipient. Platform: `GET /platform/line/summary?month=` and `GET /platform/line/logs?status&limit` via SECURITY DEFINER `platform_line_usage` / `platform_line_log` (aggregates + results only, no recipients or content). The app role can't execute any of these functions.
- UI: 系統設定 (`pages/admin/SystemSettings/`, now a folder) → `components/LineNotifyCard.tsx` (usage bar, recipients table with the 3 event checkboxes, 傳送測試通知, 移除) + `LineBindModal.tsx` (antd `QRCode` of the add-friend URL, code + countdown, polls every 3 s); actions apply immediately, outside the sticky save bar. Platform sidebar **LINE 通知** (`pages/platform/LineNotifications.tsx`: month picker, stats vs plan quota, per-gym table with inline cap `InputNumber`, log with `Segmented` filter). `api/line.ts`, platform additions in `api/platform.ts`. Rules R20–R23 in `docs/business-rules.md`. Tests `tests/test_line.py` patch `get_client`/`schedule` via the `fake_line` fixture.

## Gym LINE Official Account — member entry (ADR 0005)

- Each gym connects **its own** LINE OA (unlike ADR 0004's shared platform OA for staff). Option A: the gym creates a LINE Login channel + LIFF app **in the same Provider** as its OA (LINE user IDs are per-Provider, so LIFF login IDs then match the OA's IDs). One `line_oa_channels` row per tenant (RLS): `channel_secret_enc`/`access_token_enc` (Fernet via `core/crypto.py`, key `DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, falls back to a `SECRET_KEY` derivation — rotating `SECRET_KEY` then breaks decryption), `login_channel_id`, `liff_id` (must start with `<login_channel_id>-`, `liff_id_problem`), `is_enabled`, bot info, `rich_menu_id`, `verified_at`, `last_error`. API returns only `••••last4` hints, never the secrets.
- Admin API `routers/line_oa.py` (`/line-oa`): `GET`, `PUT` (saving always disables), `POST /verify` (`services/line_oa.run_checks`: required = LIFF/channel match + `/v2/bot/info`; warnings only = set+test webhook `https://<sub>.<BASE_DOMAIN>/api/v1/line-oa/webhook`, install rich menu from `app/static/line/rich_menu.png` with 4 LIFF links book/bookings/purchase/me, delete the old one after the new is default), `POST /disable`; public `GET /line-oa/public` (enabled, liff_id, gym name, add-friend URL); `POST /line-oa/webhook` on the **gym host** (tenant from Host, signature with that gym's secret; follow → welcome button, keywords 會員/預約/我的預約/購買 → button reply, other text ignored so staff can chat; disabled ⇒ 200 no reply). Webhook replies only; pushes to members are phase 2 (below).
- Member auth `routers/line_auth.py` (`/auth/line`): `POST` `{id_token}` → `services/line_oa.verify_id_token` (LINE `/oauth2/v2.1/verify` with **client_id = this gym's login channel**) → linked user ⇒ normal `Token`; else `{status:'unlinked', link_token}` (`create_line_link_token`, 15 min, `scope=line_link`, carries `tid` + LINE id, rejected by `get_current_user`). `POST /join` `{link_token, display_name, phone, consent}` creates a member with auto username `line-xxxxxx` and **no password** (`security.unusable_password()` → `'!'` prefix, `verify_password` always false; `User.has_password`); `POST /link` `{link_token, username, password}` (not admins, one LINE ↔ one member per gym via `uq_users_tenant_line_user`); `POST /unlink` (self, only if `has_password`). Admin: `POST /users/{id}/unlink-line`; `PUT /users/{id}` now takes optional `username`/`display_name`/`phone` (`services/members.normalize_phone`). Login token issuing shared in `services/members.issue_token`. `UserOut` adds `display_name`, `phone`, `has_password`, `line_linked`, `line_display_name`, `line_linked_at` (use `schemas/user.user_out(user, is_coach)`).
- `system_settings.payment_instructions` (付款方式說明) shown in 我的方案與訂單 for 待付款 orders; payment stays 轉帳＋後台確認.
- Frontend: `/liff/*` → `pages/liff/LiffEntry/` (dynamic-imports `@line/liff`, `liff.init` → `getIDToken` → `/auth/line`; maps `/liff/<page>` or `?liff.state=` to `/member/<page>` in `lib.ts`; `JoinPanel` = 加入會員 / 我已經是會員; dev-only `localStorage.liffMockIdToken` skips the SDK). Auth store `inLine` hides 登出/修改密碼 in `Me`, and a 401 while `inLine` goes back to `/liff`. 系統設定 → `components/LineOaCard.tsx` (status, member entry URL, add-friend QR, 檢查連線, 停用) + `LineOaWizard.tsx` (3 steps with copyable Endpoint/Webhook URLs, `CheckList`). 會員列表 shows 姓名/手機/LINE; 會員詳情 edits 姓名/手機 and has 解除綁定. `api/lineOa.ts`. Rules R24–R27; tests `tests/test_line_oa.py` (`fake_oa` patches `make_client` + `verify_id_token`).
- Phase 2 — member notifications (`services/line_member.py`, R28–R30): pushes from the gym's own OA only when **someone else** acted for the member — review result / admin-created booking (`notify_booking_result`), admin cancel with refund status (`notify_booking_cancelled`, only when `is_admin and member_id != current_user.id`), `confirm-payment` (`notify_payment_confirmed`; course plans link to `book`, 用品 to `products`), and next-day class reminders (`enqueue_reminders`: in the tenant-local window `reminder_hour`..+2h, one card per member per day, `dedupe_key reminder:<user>:<date>`). Members' own submit/cancel/order never notify. Outbox `line_member_messages` (tenant/RLS; `event` LineMemberEvent 預約成功/預約未成立/預約已取消/已收到款項/上課提醒, `user_id`, `message` cleared when finished, reuses the `linenotificationstatus` enum, `attempts`/`next_attempt_at`/`note`, unique `(tenant_id, dedupe_key)`); `line_member.schedule(background_tasks, id)` after commit, `dispatch_tenant` uses `client.push`, retries 1/5/30 min, a 429 "monthly limit" is final (方案額度用完). The ADR 0004 loop in `services/line.start_dispatch_loop` also calls `line_member.run_due()` (reminders + retries). Channel toggles `notify_booking_result`/`notify_booking_cancel`/`notify_payment_confirmed`/`notify_class_reminder`, `reminder_hour` (6–22), `member_monthly_cap` (null = no cap) via `PATCH /line-oa/notifications`; `GET /line-oa/quota` (LINE quota + consumption), `GET /line-oa/messages` (log, no content). Member opt-out `users.line_notify` via `PATCH /auth/line/preferences`. UI: `SystemSettings/components/LineMemberNotifyPanel.tsx` inside `LineOaCard` (switches, reminder `Select`, cap, usage vs LINE quota, collapsible log); 我的 has a LINE 通知 `Switch`. Tests `tests/test_line_member.py` (`pushes` fixture reuses `fake_oa`/`enabled` from `test_line_oa.py`).

## Member segments & LINE audiences (ADR 0006)

- **名單在系統篩、訊息在 LINE 官方帳號後台發**: admin sidebar **會員名單** (`pages/admin/MemberSegments/`: `SegmentFilterCard` with 常用名單 presets 續約提醒/喚回老會員/忠實會員 from `lib.ts`, stats, member table with LINE-reach `Segmented`, client-side CSV export with BOM, `CreateAudienceModal` showing count + LINE quota, history of created audiences). API `routers/member_segments.py` (admin-only): `POST /member-segments/preview` `SegmentFilters` → `SegmentResult` (`services/member_segments.find_members`: 上過課 = 已確認＋已出席 reservations in `start..end` (≤ 1 year), filters `kind` 全部/團體課/私人課 (course_id set or not), `coach_id` (reservation coach or course coach), `min_attended`, `max_remaining_hours` (paid non-用品 purchases summed), `inactive_days` (last attendance ever); excludes admins and blacklisted; each row's `reach` 可發送/未綁定 LINE/未同意優惠訊息), `POST /member-segments/audiences` `{name, filters}` (re-runs the query server-side, uploads only 可發送 LINE ids via `HttpOaClient.create_audience` → `POST /v2/bot/audienceGroup/upload`, chunks of 10,000 with `PUT` for the rest; 400 if the gym OA isn't enabled or nobody is sendable, 502 on LINE errors), `GET /member-segments/audiences`. Table `line_audiences` (tenant/RLS: name, `audience_group_id`, `filters` JSON, `member_count`, `created_by_name`) — **never stores the LINE id list**. The gym then broadcasts from LINE Official Account Manager (傳送對象 → 篩選目標 → 受眾); building an audience is free, each recipient of a broadcast costs one message on the gym's plan.
- **Marketing consent is separate from service notifications** (R31): `users.marketing_consent_at` (NULL = no; property `marketing_consent`), default off; optional checkbox in LIFF `JoinPanel` (`/auth/line/join` `marketing_consent`), toggle 優惠與活動訊息 in 我的 (`PATCH /auth/line/preferences` now takes optional `line_notify` and/or `marketing_consent`; frontend `setLinePreferences({...})`); `UserOut` adds `marketing_consent`/`marketing_consent_at`; 會員詳情 shows it read-only (admins can't consent on a member's behalf). Rules R31–R33 in `docs/business-rules.md`; tests `tests/test_member_segments.py` (`FakeOa.create_audience` in `test_line_oa.py`).

## Branches (ADR 0007)

- **分店 = a layer inside one tenant** (same URL, accounts, LINE OA, website). `branches` (tenant/RLS: `name` unique per tenant, `address`, `phone`, `is_active`, `sort_order`); never deleted, only deactivated (not the last active one, not while it has 上架 courses). `services/branches.py`: `default_branch(db)` (first active by `sort_order, id`; get-or-creates 「總店」, also reusing a pending one in `db.new`), `active_branch(db, id|None)` (None ⇒ default; 400 if missing/停用), `check_branch_ids`, `has_multiple`, `label_for` (branch name for notification cards only when > 1 active branch). Migration `0008_branches` backfilled one 總店 per tenant and pointed every course/reservation/time slot/coach at it.
- Linked data: `courses.branch_id` (required; course coach must teach there — `_check_coach_branch`; can't change branch once reservations exist), **`time_slots.branch_id` — 公休 per branch** (unique `(tenant_id, branch_id, slot_date, start_hour)`; `GET /time-slots?branch_id`, `PUT` takes `branch_id`), `reservations.branch_id` (`routers/reservations._resolve_branch`: group ⇒ the course's branch, private ⇒ payload `branch_id` or default; private coach must be in `coach.branch_ids`; a product with `branch_ids` only works at those branches; `_check_slot_open(db, branch_id, …)`), `coach_branches` (`Coach.branch_ids` property/setter via `sync_branch_rows`; ≥1; can't drop a branch where the coach still has 上架 courses), `product_branches` (`Product.branch_ids`; empty = 全分店通用; only 課程 category keeps them). **`db/session.py` `_fill_branch_id` (before_flush) assigns the default branch to new Course/Reservation/TimeSlot rows without one and to new coaches without branch rows** — single-branch callers and tests need no changes. Filters: `GET /courses?branch_id`, `GET /courses/schedule?branch_id` (rows add `branch_id`/`branch_name`; `services/schedule.group_sessions(…, branch_id)`), `GET /reservations?branch_id`, `SegmentFilters.branch_id`. LINE cards (store + member) and the website class list add the branch name only when the gym has > 1 active branch.
- API `routers/branches.py`: `GET /branches` (any user; members get active only; auto-creates 總店), `POST`/`PUT /branches/{id}` (admin; 409 on duplicate name). Frontend: `api/branches.ts`, `lib/useBranches.ts` (`branches`, `active`, `defaultId`, `nameOf`), shared `components/BranchPicker.tsx` (`Segmented` ≤ 4 options else `Select`, optional 全部分店). Admin sidebar **分店管理** (`pages/admin/Branches.tsx`, modal form, 停用/啟用); 公休設定 picks a branch first (disabled while drafts are unsaved); `CourseForm` 上課分店 + coach list filtered to that branch + per-branch 公休; `CoachForm` 授課分店 `Checkbox.Group`; `ProductForm` (課程) 適用分店 全分店通用/只限指定分店; branch column/filter in `courseColumns` (`branchName` dep), `GroupCourseList`, `BookingReviewList`, `CoachList`, `ProductList`, `MyBookings`, 會員名單. Member 預約課程 has a branch picker at the top (remembered in `localStorage.bookBranchId`), filters group sessions/private coaches/open hours by branch, skips plans not valid there, sends `branch_id`; `bookIntent` stores `branchId` and the resume flow switches branch first. `useBookingLookups().describe` adds `branchName` (首頁, 教練今日). Branch options are always shown, even with one branch. Phase 2 (not built): branch-manager admins limited to some branches. Rules R34–R36; tests `tests/test_branches.py`.

## Staff accounts & permissions (ADR 0008)

- Back-office accounts are still `users.role = admin`, plus `staff_level` (`StaffLevel` 主要管理者/管理者/一般使用者, stored `owner`/`manager`/`staff`; NULL on legacy rows ⇒ treated as manager), `permissions` (JSON list of feature codes, only used for 一般使用者) and `is_active` (停用 ⇒ `issue_token` and `get_current_user` both 403 「帳號已停用」). Exactly one owner per gym: migration `0009_staff_permissions` made each gym's earliest admin the owner; `services/staff.initial_level` makes the first admin created by the platform/`seed_admin` the owner and later ones managers; `require_owner` self-heals a gym with no owner by promoting the earliest active admin.
- **Features = admin sidebar menus** (`services/staff.PERMISSIONS`: dashboard, reservations, coaches, payouts, products, purchases, courses, availability, members, segments, website, inquiries, branches, settings; `sensitive` on coaches/payouts/members/settings — owner decides, no hard block) + built-in `TEMPLATES` 櫃台/店長/會計 (just pre-fill). `has_perm(user, *codes)` (any of), `effective_permissions` (owner/manager ⇒ all). **Every admin API is gated by `deps.require_perm(...)`**: each router defines `require_access = require_perm("<code>")` in place of the old `require_admin` (direct calls too, e.g. `require_access(current_user)`); in-handler admin checks for mutations use `has_perm`. Shared reads: `GET /users` + `GET /users/{id}` accept members/reservations/purchases/coaches/segments/inquiries/payouts/dashboard, user mutations need `members`, and **`/users/{id}*` only touch `role=member` rows** (404 for staff accounts — no resetting an owner's password through 會員管理); `POST /purchases/{id}/adjust` = purchases or members; `GET /line-oa/quota` = settings or segments; coach phone/bank/rate visible only with coaches or payouts, course `coach_fee` only with courses or payouts. Lists shared with members (reservations, purchases, courses, products) still show everything to any back-office account. `UserOut.staff` = `{level, permissions}` (None for members) via `schemas/user.user_out`.
- Owner-only API `routers/staff.py` (`/staff`): `GET /meta` (any back-office account: permission catalog + templates), `GET`, `POST` (level 管理者/一般使用者 only, `must_change_password` true, username shared with members ⇒ 409), `PUT /{id}` (display name, level up/down, permissions; owner's own level/permissions can't be changed), `POST /{id}/status`, `POST /{id}/reset-password` (not self), `POST /transfer-owner` `{user_id, password}` (re-checks the owner's password; owner ⇒ manager), `GET /logs`. Every change writes `staff_audit_logs` (tenant/RLS; actor/target names, action 新增帳號/升級/降級/修改權限/停用/啟用/重設密碼/移交主要管理者, detail like 「開啟 儀表板；關閉 預約審核」, never passwords).
- Frontend: `api/staff.ts` (`PermissionCode`, `StaffLevel`), `lib/permissions.ts` `usePermissions()` (reads `['me']`), **`components/adminMenu.tsx` `ADMIN_MENU` is the single menu ↔ permission table** (`perm: 'owner'` for 後台帳號) used by `AppLayout` (filters the sidebar, header shows the level, 詢問名單 badge query only with `inquiries`) and `router/RequirePerm.tsx` (wraps every `/admin/*` route; 403 `Result` with a link to the first allowed page; the dashboard route is `landing` so accounts without it are redirected). Login and admin logout call `queryClient.clear()`. Owner page **後台帳號** (`pages/admin/StaffAccounts/`: table + `StaffFormModal` (generated initial password shown once via `showCredentials`, level radio, `PermissionPicker` with templates and 含敏感資料 tags) + `TransferOwnerModal` + audit log). 會員名單 reads `GET /line-oa/public` for the enabled flag. Rules R37–R39; tests `tests/test_staff.py`.
- **Sidebar navigation**: each `ADMIN_MENU` entry has a `group` (`ADMIN_MENU_GROUPS` 預約與課程/會員與銷售/行銷/教練/設定; 儀表板 is ungrouped); `AppLayout` builds 釘選 → 最近使用 (5, excludes the current page and pinned ones) → 儀表板 → groups, dropping groups with no permitted item. Pins/recent live in browser storage per gym host + user id (`lib/useAdminMenuPrefs.ts`, keys only, re-filtered by permission); detail pages count as their menu via `menuEntryFor` (longest prefix). `BackOfficeShell` takes nested `menuItems` (`key` unique, `path` = route so one page can appear in several groups, `badge` — summed onto a closed group's title), `defaultOpenKeys`, `openStateStorageKey` (remembers only groups the user toggled; the current page's group opens temporarily and closes when you leave), `pinnedPaths`/`onTogglePin` (hover pin button in `BackOfficeMenuLabel`; hidden when the sider is collapsed, where groups become pop-outs). The platform console passes a flat list and is unaffected.

## Staff notifications (ADR 0009)

- Back-office **bell** (header, left of 登出) for 4 member-initiated events: 會員送出預約 (`notify_booking_submitted`), 會員自己取消預約 (`notify_booking_cancelled`, only when `reservation.member_id == current_user.id`), 會員下單待付款 (`notify_order_unpaid`), 網站體驗詢問 (`notify_inquiry`) — `services/staff_notifications.py`, called next to the ADR 0004 LINE `notify_*` calls in the same transaction. Recipients = active admins with the kind's permission (`KIND_PERM`: reservations/purchases/inquiries), excluding the actor; reads re-filter by current permission. Body = name + summary (time, course/plan, branch when > 1, amount), **never phone/email/notes** (R41).
- Table `staff_notifications` (tenant/RLS, one row per recipient: `user_id`, `kind` `StaffNotificationKind` 新預約/會員取消預約/新訂單/新詢問 stored `booking_submitted`/`booking_cancelled`/`order_unpaid`/`inquiry_new`, `title`, `body`, `link` (in-app path with `?highlight=<id>`), `read_at`, `created_at`; index `(user_id, id)`); 90-day purge on list (R42).
- API `routers/staff_notifications.py` (`require_admin`, own rows only): `GET /notifications/summary?after_id` (`unread_count`, `latest_id`, `new` = up to 10 newer than `after_id`), `GET /notifications?unread_only&before_id&limit` (`{items, has_more}`), `POST /notifications/{id}/read`, `POST /notifications/read-all`.
- Frontend `components/notifications/` (README): `NotificationBell` polls summary every 2 min (and on window focus), toasts new ones via `App.useApp().notification` (6 s, no sound, max 3 + 「還有 N 則」; none on first load; one tab only via `localStorage.staffNotifToasted:<host>:<userId>`), invalidates `QUERY_KEYS_BY_KIND` (`api/notifications.ts`); `NotificationPanel` (`useInfiniteQuery`, 全部/未讀 `Segmented`, 全部標為已讀); `useOpenNotification` (invalidate + navigate + mark read). Target pages read `?highlight=`: `lib/useHighlightRow.ts` (jump to the row's page, scroll, `colorWarningBg`) in `BookingReviewList`/`PurchaseList` (switches the status filter), `Inquiries` opens the drawer. `relativeServerTime` in `lib/datetime.ts`. Rules R40–R42; tests `tests/test_staff_notifications.py`.

## Architecture

```
backend/app/
  models/     SQLAlchemy ORM models (1 file per table)
  schemas/    Pydantic request/response models (1 file per resource)
  routers/    FastAPI route handlers (1 file per resource)
  core/       config.py (env-driven Settings), security.py (JWT + bcrypt)
  deps.py     shared FastAPI dependencies (auth/role guards)
  db/session.py  SQLAlchemy engine/session, declarative Base
  alembic/    migrations (autogenerate-driven)

frontend/src/
  api/        one file per resource, thin axios wrappers returning typed data
  pages/admin/    admin-only screens (後台, AppLayout)
  pages/member/   member front-end screens (前台, MemberLayout mode="member")
  pages/coach/    coach front-end screens (前台, MemberLayout mode="coach")
  pages/common/   Login, Register
  components/     shared UI: AppLayout (admin sidebar+header), SlotPicker (week grid), StatusTag; calendar/ (排程原子組件); member/ (前台 shell + building blocks)
  store/auth.ts   zustand store, persisted to localStorage (login survives refresh)
  router/index.tsx   route table; RequireRole.tsx guards by role
```

Every backend resource follows the same triad: `models/X.py` (table) → `schemas/X.py` (`XCreate` / `XUpdate` / `XOut`) → `routers/X.py` (registered in `main.py` under `API_V1_PREFIX` = `/api/v1`). Follow this triad for any new resource.

## Multi-tenancy (ADR 0001)

- **Tenant = one gym (company)**, `tenants` table (`subdomain` unique, `status` 試用/啟用/停用 stored `trial`/`active`/`suspended`, `timezone`). Every other table inherits `TenantMixin` (`models/tenant.py`) → `tenant_id` FK. Per-gym uniqueness is composite: `(tenant_id, username)`, `(tenant_id, code)`, `(tenant_id, slot_date, start_hour)`, one `system_settings` row per tenant.
- **Isolation is enforced by PostgreSQL RLS**, not by router code: policy `tenant_isolation` on every business table, `tenant_id = NULLIF(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::int` for USING and WITH CHECK. DB roles: `fitness_owner` (owns tables; `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL`, used by Alembic and `app.cli`), `fitness_app` (`DATABASE_URL`; NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS, DML only, SELECT-only on `tenants`, nothing on platform tables) and `fitness_platform` (platform console, see below). No tenant set ⇒ every table looks empty.
- `db/session.py`: an `after_begin` Session event runs `set_config('app.tenant_id', session.info["tenant_id"], true)` per transaction; `before_flush` fills `tenant_id` on new rows. **Never filter by `tenant_id` or set it by hand in routers** — just use the injected `db`.
- `deps.py`: async `get_tenant` resolves `Host` → `<sub>.BASE_DOMAIN` (fallback `DEFAULT_TENANT`, else 404; 停用 → 403; 30 s TTL cache, `clear_tenant_cache()`), sets the `core/tenant_context.current_tenant` contextvar; `get_db` (import it from `app.deps`, not `app.db.session`) yields a tenant-bound session; JWTs carry `tid` and `get_current_user` rejects a token whose `tid` ≠ the host's tenant. Background/CLI code uses `db.session.tenant_session(tenant_id)`.
- Per-tenant: `clock.now_local()` uses `tenants.timezone` (fallback `STUDIO_TIMEZONE`); uploads go through `core/media.save_tenant_media(kind, data, ext)` → `MEDIA_DIR/<subdomain>/<kind>/<uuid>.ext`.
- **Adding a table**: inherit `(TenantMixin, Base)` and call `enable_tenant_rls("<table>")` (`app/db/rls.py`) in its migration after `create_table` (it also grants DML to `APP_DB_ROLE`). `tests/test_tenancy.py` fails if any table lacks either (platform-level tables go in `PLATFORM_TABLE_NAMES` instead). The Alembic history was squashed into `0001_baseline` (PostgreSQL); SQLite/MySQL are no longer supported.
- Accounts are per gym: the same person at two gyms has two unrelated accounts. Per-gym custom domains and billing are later phases (see the ADR); the platform console and gym website are below.

## Data model (28 business tables + `tenants` + platform tables)

`users` (admin/member, `is_coach` is a **derived** value — true iff a `coaches` row references the user, not a stored column; `is_blacklisted` and `must_change_password` are stored flags the admin sets from 會員詳情) · `coaches` (`user_id` bind is unique; plus `name`, `alias` 授課名稱, `line_name`, `phone`, `bank_code`/`bank_account` 匯款帳號, `specialty` 專長, `photo_url`, `session_rate` 私人課每堂鐘點費 (default 0), coach types as booleans `is_private_coach` (default true) / `is_group_coach` / `is_rental_coach` exposed in the API as `coach_types: ['私人教練'|'團體課程教練'|'場租教練']` (multi-select, at least one, 場租 can't combine with the others — `schemas/coach.py` `_validate_types`); `GET /coaches/me` (`require_coach`) returns the caller's own coach row; **`GET /coaches` blanks `phone`/`line_name`/`bank_code`/`bank_account`/`session_rate` for non-admins** — never expose these to members) · `products` (catalog, three kinds via `category` enum — stored `course`/`single_course`/`supply`, API 團體課程/課程/用品: **團體課程** binds `course_id` → a `courses` row and `session_hours` mirrors that course's `session_count` (set server-side, read-only in the form, `stock` null); **課程** (單次課程) has an admin-entered `session_hours` (≥1), `course_id`/`stock` null; **用品** carries `stock` (decremented on purchase; `create_purchase` 400 「庫存不足」 when short), `session_hours` 0, `course_id` null; plus `price`, `is_active`) · `purchases` (a member's purchased session-hours; `total_hours` = 下單當下 `session_hours * quantity`, `remaining_hours` = current balance (only via `services/hours.py`); **付款狀態** `payment_status` 待付款/已付款/已取消 (stored `unpaid`/`paid`/`cancelled`) + `payment_method` 現金/轉帳/刷卡/其他 (stored `cash`/`transfer`/`card`/`other`), `payment_note`, `paid_at`, `paid_confirmed_by`, `cancelled_at`; for a 用品 purchase `total_hours`/`remaining_hours` are 0 and `products.stock` is decremented at order time) · `hour_ledger` (堂數異動紀錄: one row per change to `purchases.remaining_hours` — `delta` (+增/−扣), `balance_after`, `reason` 期初餘額/購買/預約扣抵/預約退回/手動調整 (stored `opening`/`purchase`/`reservation_deduct`/`reservation_refund`/`manual_adjust`), optional `reservation_id`, `note`, `created_by`; invariant `SUM(delta) == remaining_hours`) · `time_slots` (per-date slot-availability exception: `slot_date` + `start_hour` 10–21 + `is_open`, unique per date+hour; **no row for a date/hour = open by default**) · `system_settings` (one config row per tenant: `company_name` / `short_name` / `logo_url` / `cancel_deadline_hours` 取消期限 (default 12, 0＝不限制); lazily get-or-created — see 系統設定 below) · `courses` (團體課程 bound to a coach: auto `code` `GC-YYYY-NNN`, `status` 上架/下架/草稿, `min_capacity` 最低開班, `max_capacity` = **每堂**容量, `coach_fee` 每堂教練費 (團體課程教練鐘點用, default 0; `null` for non-admins in `GET /courses` and `GET /courses/{id}`; create/changing `coach_id` requires an `is_group_coach` coach — 400 「團體課程只能指定團體課程教練」, re-saving an existing course with its current coach is allowed), `duration_minutes` (**one value per course**), `description`, `cover_image_url`, `updated_by_name`, `is_archived`/`archived_at`/`archived_by_name`; **排程規格 lives on the course row** — `start_hour` (單一上課時間), `start_date`, `end_mode` 週數/結束日, `week_count` / `end_date`; `day_of_week` = the **min weekday** (denormalised for the list summary), all nullable for a 草稿; `session_count` = non-cancelled `course_sessions`; `start_date`/`end_date` = the schedule spec (`end_date` is the input in 結束日 mode, or `start_date` + `week_count` in 週數 mode); `enrolled_count` (API only) = **peak single-session** headcount from `reservations`) · `course_weekdays` (course_id, `weekday` ISO 1–7; the 多選 上課星期) · `course_sessions` (the展開後 課堂 list: `session_date`, `start_minute`, `duration_minutes`, `source` 排程/加開, `is_cancelled` 停課 (kept as a record, not counted); FK `ON DELETE CASCADE`) · `reservations` (status: 待確認/已確認/已拒絕/已取消; source: member_submitted/admin_created; `late_cancel` 晚取消 flag; `attendance` 已出席/未到 (stored `attended`/`no_show`, NULL＝未簽到) + `checked_in_at`/`checked_in_by`) · `coach_payouts` (教練月結 snapshot: `coach_id` + `period` (該月 1 日, unique together), `session_count`, `rate`, `amount`, `status` 已結算/已撥款 (stored `settled`/`paid`), `settled_at/by`, `paid_at/by`, `payment_note`) · `coach_payout_items` (snapshot rows: `kind` 私人課/團體課 (stored `private`/`group`), `course_id`, `title`, `session_date`, `start_hour`, `fee` 該堂教練費, `attended_count`, `no_show_count`, `members`; FK `ON DELETE CASCADE`) · `websites` / `inquiries` / `inquiry_notes` (gym website, see «Gym website») · `line_recipients` / `line_bind_codes` / `line_notifications` (LINE store notifications, see «LINE store notifications») · `line_oa_channels` (the gym's own LINE OA, see «Gym LINE Official Account»; `users` also carries `display_name`/`phone`/`line_user_id`/`line_notify`) · `line_member_messages` (pushes to members, same section) · `line_audiences` (LINE audiences built from 會員名單, see «Member segments») · `branches` / `coach_branches` / `product_branches` (see «Branches»; `courses`/`reservations`/`time_slots` carry `branch_id`) · `staff_audit_logs` (後台帳號操作紀錄, see «Staff accounts»; `users` also carries `staff_level`/`permissions`/`is_active`) · `staff_notifications` (後台鈴鐺通知, see «Staff notifications») · `reservation_addons` (coach-only "臨時加人" add-on; the `product_id` "固定為「臨時加人」商品" comment is now historical — that product category no longer exists).

**Reservation capacity** (`routers/reservations.py` `_check_capacity`): a reservation whose product/`course_id` resolves to a `courses` row is capped by that course's `max_capacity` (每堂容量) — `SUM(people_count)` of 已確認 reservations with the same `course_id` + `booking_date` + `start_hour`; no course link ⇒ no cap. (Replaced the old per-`category` `CAPACITY_BY_CATEGORY` map.)

**Enum columns store the Python enum *member name*, not the Chinese `.value`** (SQLAlchemy default): e.g. `courses.status` is stored as `on`/`off`/`draft`, `products.category` as `course`/`single_course`/`supply`, `reservations.status` as `pending`/`confirmed`/… — the API layer (Pydantic `XOut`) serializes back to the Chinese value. Alembic `sa.Enum(...)` declarations, raw SQL, and seed inserts must use the names.

**`day_of_week` is ISO-8601: `1` = 週一 … `7` = 週日** — used by `courses` (`day_of_week` = 最小上課星期; the full 多選 lives in `course_weekdays.weekday`). `time_slots` keys off a concrete `slot_date` instead. Frontend labels come from `frontend/src/lib/weekday.ts` (`weekdayLabel` / `WEEKDAY_SHORT_MON_FIRST`) — don't re-declare weekday arrays per file.

## Auth & permission model

JWT bearer tokens (`app/core/security.py`, payload `sub`/`tid`/`role`/`is_coach`), role = `admin` | `member` — `admin` is that gym's admin only. Key dependencies in `deps.py`:
- `get_current_user` — any authenticated, non-blacklisted user
- `require_admin` — any back-office account (role admin); **admin APIs use `require_perm(<feature>)` instead** (see «Staff accounts»), owner-only APIs use `require_owner`
- `require_coach` — member with a bound `coaches` row

**Established pattern for list/read endpoints that both admins and members need** (see `routers/purchases.py`, `reservations.py`, `coaches.py`, `products.py`, `courses.py`): the route itself only requires `get_current_user`; inside the handler, non-admins are **silently scoped to their own data** (e.g. `purchases`/`reservations` force-filter by `current_user.id`, ignoring any different id passed in). Mutations (`POST`/`PUT`/`DELETE`) stay `require_admin`-gated per-route. Follow this pattern rather than gating an entire router with a single `dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)]` — several routers used to do that and it silently broke member-facing pages that needed read access to catalog data (coaches/products/courses) or their own purchases/reservations.

`time_slots` is the single source of truth for slot availability — read by the settings screen, the reservation-review screens, and reservation creation (both member submit and admin create) alike.

**File uploads**: `POST /coaches/upload-photo` (multipart, admin-only, jpg/png ≤ 2MB) saves via `save_tenant_media` under `settings.MEDIA_DIR/<subdomain>/` (`/app/media`, a named volume `coach_media`) and returns a `/media/...` URL; `main.py` mounts that dir as StaticFiles at `/media`, and `frontend/nginx.conf` proxies `/media/` to the backend. Store the returned URL in `coaches.photo_url`. This is the pattern for any future upload.

**Forced password change**: when an admin resets a member's password from 會員詳情 with "會員下次登入時必須自行修改密碼" ticked, `POST /users/{id}/reset-password` sets `users.must_change_password`. `/auth/login` returns that flag in the token response; the frontend stores it and `AppLayout` redirects to `/member/change-password` (rendered outside `AppLayout`) until the member calls `POST /auth/change-password` (verifies current password, clears the flag). Enforcement is frontend-only — the API token still works elsewhere.

## Frontend conventions

Every list page follows the same shape (see `pages/admin/CoachList.tsx`, `BookingReviewList.tsx`, `MemberList.tsx` as references):
- `useQuery` (TanStack Query) for data fetching, keyed by resource name
- Antd `Table` with typed `ColumnsType<T>`
- Name/label lookups for foreign keys done client-side via `Map` built from a sibling `useQuery` (e.g. `coachNameById`), since API responses return raw ids
- Mutations via `useMutation` + `queryClient.invalidateQueries` on success, `message.success/error` for feedback
- `Popconfirm` for destructive/state-changing actions (approve/reject/cancel)

`api/*.ts` files are thin: exported TS interfaces mirroring the backend `XOut` schema, plus one async function per endpoint using the shared `apiClient` (axios instance in `api/client.ts` with JWT-injecting request interceptor and 401→logout response interceptor).

`components/SlotPicker.tsx` is the canonical week grid — a dated 7-day time grid (`dates: Dayjs[]` × 10:00–21:00) composed from the `components/calendar/` atoms (`TimeAxis`, `DayHeaderCell`, `TimeSlotCell`, `NowIndicator`, `EventBlock`); `SlotState` = `open | closed`. Optional `cellEvents(date, hour) => SlotEvent[]` prop overlays `EventBlock`s (side-by-side via `colIndex`/`colCount`; a `SlotEvent` without `onClick` gets `pointerEvents:none` so the cell stays clickable, one with `onClick` is itself clickable) — `SlotSettings` uses it to show existing reservations on closed cells (not courses). Optional `cellDisabled(date, hour) => boolean` greys out + blocks extra cells beyond the always-disabled past dates (`CourseForm` passes it for 公休 slots on its read-only preview). `SlotSettings` owns the week nav + `MiniCalendar` + legend layout. Extend `SlotPicker`/`TimeSlotCell` rather than building a parallel grid component.

`components/InlineRuleList.tsx` (`InlineRuleList` + `InlineRuleRow`) is the shared chrome for a **numbered setting-row list** — a soft panel with title/description, rows each carrying a `規則 N` / `設定 N` chip (`chipPrefix` via context) and a trailing delete button, plus a dashed 新增一列 button (`readOnly` hides the add + per-row delete buttons). Row *contents* stay with the caller. Used by `Availability`'s 快速設定 (批次關閉); reuse it for any future batch-rule editor rather than re-styling a panel.

`components/courseColumns.tsx` (`sharedCourseColumns({ coachNameById })`) + `components/CourseCoverThumb.tsx` are the 7 course-row columns (封面 / 課程名稱 / 教練 / 開班人數 / 課程介紹 / 課堂數 / 開課時間) shared by `GroupCourseList` and `GroupCourseArchive`; each page spreads them then appends its own columns (狀態＋操作 / 封存資訊＋還原刪除).

`components/calendar/` holds 8 presentational scheduling atoms imported from the PulseFit design system (`TimeAxis`, `TimeSlotCell`, `DayHeaderCell`, `EventBlock`, `EventChip`, `NowIndicator`, `MonthDayCell`, `MiniCalendar`) — colours/radius/font via `theme.useToken()`, no global CSS. See `components/calendar/README.md`.

When **authoring or reviewing a UI component** (not a page screen), follow `.claude/skills/component-conventions/SKILL.md`: where it lives (shared `frontend/src/components/` for 2+ consumers vs. page-scoped `frontend/src/pages/<Area>/<Page>/components/` for a single consumer), reach for an Ant Design component before hand-rolling, colours/radius via `theme.useToken()` (no hardcoded hex), `dayjs` for all date work, one shared source for constants/helpers, controlled props-driven components, and "one concept, one component". The layout shell (`AppLayout.tsx`, header, sidebar) has its own `.claude/skills/layout-conventions/SKILL.md`.

## Implementation status

**Done**: all list/read screens — CoachList, ProductList, MemberList, BookingReviewList, SlotSettings, GroupCourseList, GroupCourseArchive (admin); MyBookings, MyProducts (member); Login/Register. Implemented forms/flows: ProductForm, PurchaseEntry, CreateBooking, CourseForm (admin); SubmitBooking, BuyProduct (member).

**購買方案** (`/member/purchase`, `pages/member/BuyProduct/`): card-style member purchase page — `PlanCard` per active product (member-facing category labels 團體課/私人課/商品 from `lib.ts` `MEMBER_CATEGORY_LABEL`, 堂數 or 庫存, price + 每堂約 for multi-session plans, sold-out 用品 disabled), `Segmented` category filter, and an `OrderSheet` bottom sheet (數量, 入帳堂數, 應付金額 → `POST /purchases/self`, then a success state showing `system_settings.payment_instructions`). `PurchaseSelfCreate` = `product_id` + `quantity` only; the endpoint forces `user_id`/`created_by` = current user, `purchase_date` = today, and `amount` = `product.price * quantity` server-side — the client-sent amount is never trusted. Shares `_build_purchase` in `routers/purchases.py` with the admin `POST /purchases` (課程類 → `remaining_hours = session_hours * quantity`; 用品 → decrement `products.stock`, 400 「庫存不足」). **Buy-then-book**: when 預約課程's `ConfirmSheet` has no usable plan, 購買方案 saves the class to `lib/bookIntent.ts` (localStorage, 14 days, `saveBookIntent`/`loadBookIntent`/`clearBookIntent`) and opens `/member/purchase?from=book`, which highlights plans that fit (R15 rules, `fitsIntent`) and sorts them first; if a fitting plan is still 待付款 the sheet shows 查看付款方式 instead (payment rules unchanged — unpaid plans can't book). Once paid, opening 預約課程 auto-opens that class's sheet (skipped/cleared if the class passed, is already booked, or isn't in the 7-day schedule), and a successful booking clears the intent. The LINE 已收到款項 card for course plans links to `book`. Shared bottom sheet chrome: `components/member/BottomSheet.tsx` (used by `ConfirmSheet` and `OrderSheet`).

Also done: `ProductForm`, `PurchaseEntry`, `SubmitBooking`, `BookingReviewDetail`, `MemberDetail`, `CoachForm`. `ProductForm` 分類 is 團體課程/課程/用品: **團體課程** picks a `course_id` — only 上架 courses are offered (edit mode also keeps the currently-bound one), and the backend `_normalize_product_fields` rejects binding a **new** non-上架 course ("只能綁定上架中的課程"; re-saving with the same course is allowed even after it goes 下架) — then shows the course's `session_count` as a read-only 堂數; **課程** takes a free `session_hours` (≥1, 單次課程); **用品** takes `stock`. `SubmitBooking` offers every non-用品 active product; `PurchaseEntry` blocks out-of-stock 用品 options. `MemberDetail` (帳號/密碼/黑名單維護) is the reference for the 會員詳情 design handoff — controlled local state + a sticky save bar that fires only the mutations for fields that actually changed (`PUT /users/{id}` for username, `POST /users/{id}/reset-password`, `PUT /users/{id}/blacklist`). `CoachForm` serves both `/admin/coaches/new` and `/admin/coaches/:id/edit` (edit prefills from the `['coaches']` list cache, shows 綁定帳號 read-only with a 不可變更 tag, adds a card-`extra` id/created line, a dirty-gated 儲存變更, and a 刪除教練資料 button that opens a confirm `Modal` → `DELETE /coaches/{id}`) — same sticky-save-bar shape; on new, 綁定帳號 is a keyword search over `['members']` that dims accounts already bound to a coach.

**系統設定** (`/admin/settings`, `pages/admin/SystemSettings/index.tsx`) manages the gym's single `system_settings` row (one per tenant) (`company_name`, `short_name`, `logo_url`, `cancel_deadline_hours`, `payment_instructions`) via `GET/PUT /system-settings` (`GET` open to any authenticated user — read by `AppLayout`'s sidebar for both admin and member — `PUT` and `POST /system-settings/upload-logo` admin-only) — same sticky-save-bar/dirty-diff shape as `MemberDetail`, logo upload deferred-to-save like `CoachForm`'s photo picker. The row is lazily get-or-created on first read rather than seeded via migration. Logo uploads accept jpg/png only (no svg, to avoid stored-XSS from inline-rendered SVG).

**課程管理 is being split into 團體課程 and 私人教練課程**: `/admin/courses` now renders `GroupCourseList` — the group-course management list, faithful to the Claude Design spec (`GroupCourseList.dc.html`): name/coach filters + 開課期間 `DatePicker.RangePicker` + status filter, inline 上架/下架 toggle (`PATCH /courses/{id}/status`), cover thumbnail, auto course `code`, capacity range (每堂上限), 課堂數, 開課起訖 + 多星期摘要 (每週一、三、五 …), edit tracking. The old plain `CourseList` table is kept at `/admin/private-courses` as the not-yet-built 私人教練課程 starting point (not in the sidebar menu yet).

**團體課程 新增／編輯／複製 (`CourseForm`, `pages/admin/CourseForm/`)**: 課程資訊 card (name/coach/最低開班/每堂人數上限/單堂時長 (`InputNumber` 分鐘)/介紹/封面 — cover via `POST /courses/upload-cover`, mirrors `coaches/upload-photo`); **課程時段 card = a single 排程規格** (`ScheduleSpecForm`: 上課星期 `Checkbox.Group` 多選 · 上課時間 `Select` (單一) · 開課期間 起日 + 週數/結束日 可切換), NOT a rule list. `CourseForm/lib/recurrence.ts` shrank to `expandSchedule(spec, cancelled, extras, isSlotClosed, confirmedDates)` → `PreviewSession[]` (每個勾選星期在期間內一堂; a 排程 session whose slot is 公休 **and** whose date is not in `confirmedDates` (edit-mode = the already-saved 正常 session dates) is flagged `closedSlot` — **not shown** in the sessions table or the calendar, excluded from 堂數 and from `toSessionPayload`; the gap is surfaced only by the 「開課期間」 summary note 「(N 堂落在公休時段，不會建立)」; so a course keeps its saved 堂數 in edit even if slots close later, and only newly-added dates get flagged; dedup (date, hour)). `SessionsTable` (below, **grouped & ordered by weekday** 週一…週日 then date, with a 週X group header): per-row 停課/恢復 toggle (正常 排程 sessions) + 移除 (加開 sessions) + a 「加開單堂」 `Popover` (`DatePicker`+`Select`, 公休 blocked); `closedSlot` sessions are filtered out entirely. `SchedulePreviewCalendar` is **read-only** — `SlotPicker` with week-nav, 公休 slots greyscale (`cellDisabled`), this course's non-公休 sessions as blocks (停課 → `tone:'gray'` + 「（停課）」). 課程狀態 radio, sticky save bar via `usePageActionBar`. One route component serves `courses/new` · `courses/:id/edit` · `courses/:id/duplicate` (mode from the path). Edit → load spec + sessions from `GET /courses/{id}`; duplicate → prefill info, clear schedule, status 下架. **Editing a course whose saved `status` is 上架 and that still has a future non-cancelled 課堂 locks the whole 課程時段 section read-only** (`ScheduleSpecForm` disabled, no 停課/加開, `Alert` telling the admin to set 下架/草稿 first) — course-info fields and the status radio stay editable. **封存** button → `POST /courses/{id}/archive`; archived courses leave `GroupCourseList` (`?archived=false`) and appear in **`GroupCourseArchive`** (`/admin/courses/archived`, `?archived=true`) with 還原 (`POST /courses/{id}/restore` — back to list, forced 下架) and 永久刪除 (`DELETE /courses/{id}` — archived-only, 409 if any `reservations` reference it). `GroupCourseArchive` (faithful to `GroupCourseArchive.dc.html`: shared course columns + separate 封存時間/封存者/最後編輯時間/編輯者 columns, `showTotal` pager, `RollbackOutlined` 返回, `Empty` empty-state) starts empty until courses are archived.

**Still stub placeholders** (`Card` with a TODO paragraph, ~16 lines) — these are the next things to implement when asked: `CoachPurchaseQuery`, `BookingReviewDetail` (admin); `AddPerson` (member). When implementing a form page, check the matching router in `backend/app/routers/` first — `products` has no `DELETE` endpoint by design; `courses` gained `DELETE` (archived-only, reservation-guarded) for the 封存課程 flow.

**堂數帳務 (`app/services/hours.py`)**: **every** change to `purchases.remaining_hours` must go through this module (never assign it directly) so a `hour_ledger` row is written alongside. Its functions only `add`/`flush`; the router commits once at the end, so e.g. 建立預約＋扣抵 is one transaction and rolls back together (400 「剩餘堂數不足」 leaves no reservation behind). Rules: creating a reservation (member submit *or* admin create) with a `purchase_id` deducts `HOURS_PER_RESERVATION` (1 堂, independent of `people_count`) after checking the purchase belongs to `member_id`, is not 用品, and has the same `product_id`; 已拒絕 (review) and 已取消 refund the reservation's **net** ledger amount (idempotent — never refunds more than was deducted); review is only allowed on 待確認. Admin manual correction: `POST /purchases/{id}/adjust` (`change` ≠ 0, `note` required, balance can't go < 0); history: `GET /purchases/{id}/ledger` (members: own only). Tests live in `backend/tests/`. Confirmed business rules (堂數扣抵／退回 etc., with confirmation dates and the tests that pin them) are recorded in **`docs/business-rules.md`** — update that file first if a change alters one of those rules.

**購買付款流程**: admin `POST /purchases` (購買紀錄登錄, `payment_method` required in the form) creates **已付款** and credits `total_hours` at once; member `POST /purchases/self` (購買商品) creates **待付款** with `remaining_hours` 0 — unusable for booking (`deduct_for_reservation` 400 「購買紀錄尚未付款，無法扣抵」) until an admin calls `POST /purchases/{id}/confirm-payment` (`payment_method` required, `payment_note` optional) from **購買紀錄** (`/admin/purchases`, `PurchaseList.tsx`, sidebar item; `Segmented` filter 待付款/已付款/已取消/全部, defaults to 待付款), which credits `total_hours` via `record_purchase`. `POST /purchases/{id}/cancel` (admin any, member own) only works on 待付款 and returns 用品 stock. `GET /purchases` accepts `payment_status` and returns newest first. `adjust` only works on 已付款. Members see 付款狀態 and can 取消訂單 in 我的商品. `StatusTag` also colours 待付款/已付款. Rules R4–R7 (confirmed 2026-10-24) are in `docs/business-rules.md`.

**取消期限與簽到 (`app/services/booking_rules.py`)**: a reservation's class time is `booking_date` + `start_hour` in **studio local time** (the tenant's `tenants.timezone`; `settings.STUDIO_TIMEZONE` fallback, default Asia/Taipei); compare against `app.core.clock.now_local()` — call it as `clock.now_local()` (module attribute) so tests can monkeypatch it. `POST /reservations/{id}/cancel` takes an optional body `{refund}` (admin-only override): cancelling a **已確認** reservation within `cancel_deadline_hours` of start is allowed but not refunded and sets `late_cancel`; 待確認 always refunds; non-admins can't cancel a 已確認 reservation once it has started; reservations with an `attendance` can't be cancelled. `POST /reservations/{id}/attendance` `{attendance}` on 已確認 only: the member themself may mark 已出席 from 30 min before start until class end (course `duration_minutes`, else 60) and not change it; admins and the reservation's coach (`coach_id`, or the course's coach) may mark 已出席/未到 from 30 min before start with no upper bound, 未到 only after start. Neither refunds hours. `GET /reservations/coaching` (`require_coach`) lists a coach's 已確認 reservations with `member_username` (coaches can't read the member list). Frontend mirrors the timing rules in `frontend/src/lib/booking.ts` for button visibility only (backend is authoritative; keep constants in sync). UI: 我的預約 (簽到 button, late-cancel warning), 預約審核列表 (出席 column, 簽到/未到, late-cancel refund-choice modal), coach-only sidebar item **學員簽到** (`/member/coaching`, `CoachAttendance.tsx`), 系統設定 預約規則 card. Rules R8–R10 in `docs/business-rules.md`.

**教練鐘點結算 (`app/services/payouts.py`, `routers/coach_payouts.py`)**: billable = 已確認 reservations with `attendance` 已出席 or 未到 in the month (by `booking_date`), excluding ones where the member is the coach themself (場租); a reservation with a `course_id` belongs to that course's coach and is grouped so one course+date+hour = 1 堂 at **`courses.coach_fee`**, otherwise it's 1 堂 at **`coaches.session_rate`** for its `coach_id` — only if that coach `is_private_coach` (場租教練's clients are never paid). Amount = sum of item `fee`s; `coach_payouts.rate` is just the private-rate snapshot. Summary lists only 私人教練/團體課程教練 (plus any coach that already has a payout that month) and returns `coach_types` + `has_zero_fee`. Admin endpoints: `GET /coach-payouts/summary?month=YYYY-MM` (per coach live count/amount + existing payout + `changed_since_settled`), `GET /coach-payouts/live?coach_id&month`, `POST /coach-payouts` `{coach_id, month}` (month must have ended in studio time; 409 if already settled; 400 if no sessions) snapshots rate/amount/items, `POST /coach-payouts/{id}/mark-paid` `{payment_note}`, `DELETE /coach-payouts/{id}` (void, not when 已撥款). Coaches: `GET /coach-payouts/mine`, `GET /coach-payouts/{id}` (own only). UI: admin sidebar **教練鐘點** (`/admin/coach-payouts`, `CoachPayouts.tsx`: month picker, expandable rows via shared `components/PayoutItemsTable.tsx`, 結算 / 標記已撥款 modal showing bank account / 取消結算, 未設定 rate warning), coach-only **我的鐘點** (`/member/payouts`, `MyPayouts.tsx`), `CoachForm` 教練類型 `Checkbox.Group` (picking 場租 clears the others) + 私人課鐘點費 (only when 私人教練), `CourseForm` 每堂教練費 field and coach `Select` limited to 團體課程教練 (edit keeps the current one). `AppLayout` reads `GET /coaches/me` for coach members to show their types in the header and to add 我的鐘點 only for 私人/團體課程教練; 學員簽到 shows for every coach. Member list/detail label coaches generically as 教練. Rules R11–R14 in `docs/business-rules.md`.

**前台（會員／教練）** — a separate mobile-first shell, `components/member/MemberLayout.tsx` (see the `layout-conventions` skill and `components/member/README.md`): one centred column (max 560px) + fixed bottom tab bar, themed per mode by a nested `ConfigProvider` with `FRONT_THEMES` from `components/member/memberTheme.ts` (member 品牌藍 `#0958d9`, coach 深青綠 `#006d75`; the only place front-end colours are defined). Routes: `/member/*` (`mode="member"`: `dashboard` → `pages/member/Home`, `book` → `pages/member/Book`, `bookings`, `products`, `purchase`, `me` → `pages/member/Me.tsx`; legacy `bookings/submit` form kept; `/member/coaching` and `/member/payouts` redirect) and `/coach/*` (`mode="coach"`, coach-only: `today` → `pages/coach/Today`, `attendance` → `pages/coach/Attendance.tsx`, `payouts` → `pages/coach/Payouts.tsx` (tab only for 私人／團體課程教練), `me`). Coaches land on `/coach/today` after login and switch modes from 我的. `AppLayout` is now admin-only. **Home**: plan card (newest 已付款 purchase with hours left), 待付款 banner, 下一堂課 card (self 簽到 when `selfCheckInOpen`, cancel with late-cancel warning), 接下來 list. **Book**: 團體課/私人課 `Segmented`, 7-day `DateStrip`, group sessions from **`GET /courses/schedule?start&end`** (≤31 days; 上架, unarchived, non-cancelled sessions with `booked_count` = 待確認+已確認 people, `coach_name`, and the caller's `my_reservation_id/status`), private = pick a 私人教練 + an open hour; a bottom-sheet `Drawer` (`ConfirmSheet`) shows the **auto-picked plan** (R15: group → paid purchase whose product `course_id` matches; private → paid 課程 purchase; oldest first) and posts the normal `POST /reservations` with that `product_id`/`purchase_id`. **Coach Today**: today's `GET /reservations/coaching` grouped into units (group = course+date+hour), stats (今日課程/今日學員/本月已帶), expandable rosters with 簽到/未到 and correction. Shared front-end lookups: `lib/useBookingLookups.ts`; time helpers in `lib/booking.ts` (`classEnd`, `selfCheckInOpensAt`, `relativeStartLabel`). Use `App.useApp().message` in new pages (not the static `message`).

**Server timestamps are naive UTC** (`datetime.utcnow()`): always display them with `formatServerTime()` from `frontend/src/lib/datetime.ts` (dayjs utc → local), never `dayjs(value).format(...)` directly — that shows UTC as local time (8 hours off in Taipei).

**Known backend gaps**: add-on people (`reservation_addons`) don't yet decrement hours; no refund flow for 已付款 purchases.

## Dev workflow

- **Always use Docker for running the full stack**: `docker compose up --build`. Services: `postgres` (5432; roles created by `docker/postgres/init-roles.sh`), `backend` (8000, docs at `/docs`), `frontend` (80, nginx reverse-proxies `/api/*` keeping `Host`), `adminer` (8080, DB browsing UI — server `postgres`, DB `fitness_studio`, owner `fitness_owner`/`changeme_owner` unless overridden by `.env`). Each gym is `http://<subdomain>.localhost`; plain `http://localhost` uses `DEFAULT_TENANT` (default `demo`).
- At container start the entrypoint runs migrations, provisions `DEFAULT_TENANT` (`python -m app.cli create-tenant`, idempotent) and seeds that gym's admin from `ADMIN_USERNAME`/`ADMIN_PASSWORD` (`backend/app/seed_admin.py --tenant`); the `/auth/register` endpoint always creates `role=member`.
- PostgreSQL 16 is required everywhere (RLS); there is no SQLite/MySQL fallback. Local non-Docker dev needs the `fitness_owner`/`fitness_app` roles (see `docker/postgres/init-roles.sh`) and `backend/.env` `DATABASE_URL` + `MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL`. Provision a gym with `python -m app.cli create-tenant`.
- A gym's home page `/` is its server-rendered public website once published (else `/login`); edit it from the admin 形象網站 page.
- Platform console: `http://platform.localhost` (first platform admin from `PLATFORM_ADMIN_USERNAME`/`PLATFORM_ADMIN_PASSWORD` or `python -m app.cli create-platform-admin`). `npm run dev` proxies `/api` + `/media` to `:8000` keeping `Host`, so `<subdomain>.localhost:5173` works too.
- Frontend build check: `cd frontend && npm run build` (runs `tsc -b && vite build`) — run this after any TSX change before considering it done.
- Backend tests: `cd backend && pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python -m pytest -q` (pytest on a real PostgreSQL `fitness_test` DB, connected as the RLS-restricted app role, each test rolled back; `client` hits `alpha.localhost`, `beta_client`/`beta_db`/`beta_admin` for cross-tenant tests; `backend/tests/`; also run by the `backend-tests` CI job). Add/adjust tests with any change to booking or 堂數 logic.
